_comment: Batch 023 -- PROPOSAL: theme landmark language. Silhouettes only.
The silhouette is the harder of the two tests a landmark has to pass.
A landmark is a thing you recognise from across a room before you can
read a single texel of its material, so if it does not survive being
reduced to a shape it is a large prop with a good texture.
Player-scale views, room context and the 1.8 m human reference are in
Landmarks.gd, because the shot runner has no human-scale reference and
the owner asked for the same one across all six.
NOTHING HERE IS INTEGRATION-READY. The audit in build_landmarks.py
found no landmark placement contract and no engine seam at all --
godot/scripts reads no .glb and no manifest. See interface req 24.
The key is `variants` (an array), not `variant`. Written singular the runner silently ignored it and shipped six lit frames labelled SILHOUETTE -- a caption claiming a test that had not run.
